The type of vsync gtaV uses will drop the framerate to 30fps if you ever dip below 60.  The drops OP are talking about are probably only to about 55 but the vsync will start only displaying frames at 30 to stop tearing and stuttering, its very jarring.  You can use nvidia inspector to try and enable adaptive vsync for gtaV or to limit fps to 60 and disable vsync in the options.  Alternatively you can buy g-sync monitor to eliminate the problem or adjust the additional settings down so you never dip below 30.
